objective: Determine how the Film Grunge grain equation changes a synthetic translucent edge under straight and premultiplied RGB input conventions and black, gray, and white compositing backgrounds.

scope.effect: ArtifactFilmGrungeEffect per-pixel grain term only, grainAmount .075, grainSize 1.4 (rounded block 1), seed 1977, frame 0. Gate weave, exposure flicker, scratches, dust, vignette, stain are set to neutral values.
scope.method: Independent model reuses the intended modulo-2^32 hash interpretation documented in grunge-grain-spatial-scale-r1. It does not execute C++ or establish product input alpha mode.
input_representations: Straight RGB with retained hidden color where alpha=0.
Premultiplied RGB where input color is multiplied by alpha.
excluded: source image decoder and renderer alpha conversions
physical film reference and aesthetic approval

comparison.baseline: Same alpha/color fixture with grainAmount=0, composited using the representation's corresponding equation.
comparison.candidate: Source-equation grain added independently to stored B/G/R channels while alpha is copied unchanged.
comparison.ground_truth: None; paired baseline isolates modeled grain response and is not an aesthetic oracle.
comparison.acceptance: Describe composited residual and premultiplied bound violations. No assumption that either input mode is the product caller contract and no visual quality pass/fail.

materials.source: Generated 256x128 float32 ellipse with smooth 8px alpha transition, opaque interior, transparent exterior, and fixed foreground RGB.
materials.rights: Synthetic diagnostic generated by the script.
materials.input_rgb: Logical RGB [.82,.34,.12] is explicitly reordered to canonical physical BGRA storage before applying the effect model.

conditions.resolution: One 256x128 synthetic plate; resolution parity is not part of this experiment.
conditions.numeric_domain: Float32 normalized direct numeric RGB values, with no transfer conversion. This is algebraic compositing, not product display color management.
conditions.alpha: Alpha is unchanged by the modeled grain equation. Straight composite is C*alpha + background*(1-alpha); premultiplied composite is C + background*(1-alpha). Candidate display PNGs are clipped to [0,1] and encoded as direct RGB8 diagnostic views.
conditions.measurements: Per alpha region, record stored RGB residual and composited MAE/RMS/max, zero-alpha changed fraction, unclamped range, and bounded-color premultiplication violations RGB<0 or RGB>alpha.
conditions.seed_and_frame: Seed 1977, frame 0; known intended-wrap caveat inherited from the spatial scale study.

effect_correctness.method: Verify source markers, deterministic field, alpha passthrough, and expected association-specific composite equations.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: Equations reproduce exactly within float32 tolerance; report mode-dependent differences without selecting a product mode.

image_quality_and_detail.judge: Research author inspects identical-display-condition contact sheet.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: No aesthetic judgment; show full crop and 1:1 edge crop.

color_and_alpha.method: Paired composite on black/gray/white and premultiplied bound metrics.
color_and_alpha.unverified: Actual source and output descriptors, host conversion, product background composite.

temporal_stability.reason: Single fixed frame; temporal behavior is covered by a separate plan.

performance.reason: No product runtime or allocation measurement.

execution.thresholds: No perceptual thresholds. Invariants: alpha passthrough, deterministic field, exact formula-level compositing within float32 tolerance.
execution.reproducibility: Record plan/source/script hashes, model/imported-script hashes, versions, raw metrics and checksum.
